additionalProperties.comment: Candidate custom OSOS load/handoff path. Reads initial 0x800-byte header, obtains ROM protocol db5f87fa-eef3-48d1-b474-bc6c6f503681; header call 0x3d8, body call through 0x4a0, final handoff 0x4d2. Legacy fallback uses ImageManagerSecurity. No patch applied or device execution tested.
additionalProperties.name: NOR research

additionalProperties.comment: Bounded staged-file test stops HERE, replacing final CPU-mode helper and OS jump with movs r0,r4; BL after_bds; halt. Real central loader at 0x2e7 uses private test protocols and real DXE AllocatePages. Bds selector 0x934 includes SetInfo/update path; do not dispatch it as read-only. See BDS-STAGED.md. NOT hardware tested.
additionalProperties.name: NOR research

additionalProperties.comment: Legacy-path gate passed as load_image argument 3. Starts enabled=1; permits legacy only if two hardware values and GPIO 0x400/0x401 satisfy conditions. Live values not measured. See OSOS-HANDOFF.md.
